title: Golden State Warriors Name RingCentral Official Agentic AI Powered Voice Platform for Fan Engagement
body_markdown:
October 22, 2026


# Golden State Warriors Name RingCentral Official Agentic AI Powered Voice Platform for Fan Engagement


*Decade-long partnership expands to Agentic AI Powered Voice Platform for the fan experience*


SAN FRANCISCO & BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[RingCentral, Inc.](https://www.ringcentral.com/) (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, and the Golden State Warriors today announced an expansion of their decade-long partnership, naming RingCentral the team’s official Agentic AI Powered Voice platform for fan engagement. Together, the two organizations will work to elevate the fan experience, from ticket inquiries to game-day questions and ongoing engagement.


“The Warriors have built one of the most passionate fanbases in sports, and we’re proud to help power what comes next,” said Kira Makagon, President & COO of RingCentral. “Agentic Voice AI is changing the game. It brings a new dimension to our partnership and helps fans stay connected with the team in new ways."


Over the past decade, the Warriors have grown their organization from a single Oakland office to locations in San Francisco, Santa Cruz, and facilities managed through Golden State Sports Academy, with a staff five times the size. RingCentral has kept every location connected along the way. RingCentral delivered when it mattered most in March 2020, when the Warriors shifted eligible teams to remote work. With the RingCentral softphone on laptops and the mobile app on phones, staff kept their phone lines running and stayed in touch with season ticket members, corporate partners, community members, and fans from their business numbers, without disruption.


“RingCentral has been a trusted partner for more than a decade, helping us stay connected as our organization has grown and evolved,” said Brandon Schneider, President & Chief Operating Officer of Golden State. “As we look to the future, we’re excited to build on that foundation and explore how emerging technologies can enhance the fan experience. This expanded partnership reflects our shared commitment to innovation and finding new ways to better serve Warriors fans.”


**About RingCentral**


RingCentral is a global leader in AI–powered customer engagement, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. Powered by advanced AI capabilities, RingCentral delivers intelligence at every phase of the conversation journey — before, during, and after each human interaction. With RingCentral, businesses can work smarter, respond faster, and connect more meaningfully with their customers. Visit[ringcentral.com](http://ringcentral.com/) to learn more.

**About Golden State Warriors**


The Golden State Warriors, in their 81st season, are a charter member of the National Basketball Association. Founded in 1946 as the Philadelphia Warriors, the team moved to the West Coast in 1962 and spent nine seasons as the San Francisco Warriors before moving across the Bay to Oakland in 1971 and becoming the Golden State Warriors. In 2019, the Warriors returned to San Francisco to play at Chase Center, a privately financed, state-of-the-art 18,064-seat arena in the Mission Bay neighborhood. The team’s storied history includes seven NBA Championships, 12 NBA Finals appearances, an NBA-record 73-win season, eight members of the NBA’s 75th Anniversary Team, and 33 members of the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame.
